question: Therefore indeed this very supreme one having Dakṣiṇā and Aghorā form, because it will be said in the circle of beings granting the fruit of Śiva's abode?
premises: this very supreme one has Dakṣiṇā and Aghorā form
it will be said in the circle of beings
it grants the fruit of Śiva's abode
inference: The supreme Dakṣiṇā-Aghorā form is proclaimed among beings and grants Śiva's abode.
plain_english: Therefore indeed this very supreme one, having Dakṣiṇā and Aghorā form, will be said in the circle of beings as granting the fruit of Śiva's abode.
